Bang -! !

The thunder of the thunder seemed to ring in the ear, and Mu Yan woke up from the shackles.

The burning pain from her body made her unable to bear the pain.

She slowly opened her eyes and found herself lying in a narrow, dark, enclosed space.

The tip of the nose faintly smelled a scent of medicine.

What is this?

Mu Yan tried to run the body's mysterious spirit -

Congenital martial arts, even in the dark can be seen.

However, suddenly, a bit of painful pain hit.

The meridians of the whole body, as if they were torn by the hot force, will break at any time.

"what--!"

Mu Yan screamed and fell down. The intense pain made her all wet with cold sweat.

What happened in the end?

She remembers that she has just reached the congenital perfection.

My friend Gong Qianxue found a forging body for her, helping her to hit the first realm of the journey to the immortality - forging.

Thousands of snow accompanied her on Lei Mingfeng. After Xuanqi operated again and again, nine days of robbery came.

Mu Yan Ming Ming remembered that she had withstood eight heavenly thunders.

Only need to block the ninth thunder, you can advance the forging situation.

Then, she felt a great pain in the whole body and passed out.

Is it because she failed to cross the robbery?

Mu Yanzhen was afraid, and the sudden glare of light lit up from above.

She barely looked at it, and when she saw the beautiful face that appeared above, she immediately surprised: "Thousands of snow!"

However, Gong Qianxue did not smile at her as usual, but looked at her with contempt.

Mu Yan felt that something was wrong. She forgot a look around and found out that she was in a Dan furnace.

The face of Gong Qianxue was from the hole above the Dan furnace.

"Thousands of snow, what is going on? Is it because I have failed, so you are trying to cure me?"

Gong Qianxue was a glimpse first, and then couldn't help but laughed: "Jun Muyan, are you really stupid than pigs? Actually, I thought I was for you."

"You, what do you mean by this?"

"What do you mean? Hehe, do you think I will give you a forged body Dan to let you spend thunder? Idiom, tell you honestly, the forged body Dan can really help you thunder, but it is very poisonous. When you experience nine thunder and start to sculpt the soul, the poison will attack."

"Don't be kidding again." Mu Yan struggled to get up, hoarse and eager. "Thousands of snow, I know you like to play tricks with me. Is this fake? Right? You are not saying, am I your best friend?" ?"

"Best friend? Just rely on a low-lying woman from a lower country, also with?!" Gong Qianxue smiled. "Do you think that I have tried my best to use the best medicine to make you achieve congenital perfection?" That's because your body contains a hint of celestial elements, and the celestial element can only be motivated after experiencing a nine-thousand thunder. Haha, as you are now, is my best alchemy material."

“Alchemy material?” Mu Yan was cold and felt that her world had collapsed at this moment.

Since the accident, she did not believe in anyone in the world.

However, Gong Qianxue was regarded as the best friend and relative.

For Gong Qianxue, she learned to configure mystery and learn medicine.

For Gong Qianxue, she was born and died for her into a dangerous situation, just because she said that she had what she wanted.

But now, Gong Qianxue told her that it is all fake!

She is good to herself, just want to take her body to make alchemy? !

At this moment, a gentle voice was heard from outside the Dan furnace.

"Sister, Xuan medicine has been prepared."

"Trouble your brother!" Gong Qianxue’s voice immediately turned from a bitter to a soft delight.

Jun Muyan saw the face exposed from the hole above the Dan furnace, and changed from Gong Qianxue to a young man.

She knows this man!

He is the brother of Gong Qianxue in Tian Daozong, Jian Feng, is a genius alchemy teacher.

I saw Jian Feng throwing the mysterious medicine into the Dan furnace, and looked at her with sneer and pity.

"Senior brother, this time alchemy will be the same as when refining the fairy 12 years ago? Xianli is too rich to cause the frying furnace, and finally I can absorb it, only one of the cents of the fairy."

"Oh, my sister is relieved. With the last experience, this time will not fail again. Moreover, she is only the mother of the fairy, and the power of the fairy and the fairy are incomparable."

Listening to the conversation between the two, the pupil of Mu Yan's blood is a little bit big.

Fairy, ten years ago, the mother...

No, not what she thought, the fairy that was taken to refine the medicine, could not be her child!

However, there is a voice in my mind who is yelling and telling her -

That is her child, her child was smelted into a drug by Gong Qianxue!

"Miyachiki--!!" Mu Yan suddenly stood up from the Dan furnace, as if she was crazy, she kept struggling out. "Miyachiki, what do you say, the fairy, where is it?!!"

Gong Qianxue’s gaze was swept over the face of Jun Muyan’s beautiful and beautiful face, and the hatred in her heart almost overflowed.

She doesn't understand why a low-lying woman from Jun Moyan's inferior country is pregnant with a fairy.

The fairy is so powerful that it can be seen how the child's father is supreme.

Jun Muyan, why? !

but it does not matter!

Anyway, this fairy has been eaten by her, and now even Jun Muyan will become her stepping stone.

Gong Qianxue revealed a malicious smile, close to Mu Yan's ear and said: "The fairy, of course, was cut out from your belly ten years ago! Oh, the seven-month-old baby, from your belly. When I dug it out, it was still alive! When I was thrown into the alchemy furnace, I was also screaming like a mother-in-law!"

Mu Yan listened dumbly, and the ear seemed to sound the cry of the child's heartbreaking lungs.

The pain of the cone-shaped bones spread from her heart to every meridian of the body.

Her child, she thought that the child killed by the best relatives, the original real murderer is Gong Qianxue!

Then the burning is the mad hatred of the bones: "Miyachiki! Palace Qianxue!! I want to kill you--! I will kill you!"

"When I refine you into a medicinal herb, swallowing it into the abdomen, you will be able to achieve the rare body of the fairy, you want to kill me, the next life! Hahahaha!"

The top cover of the Dan furnace was closed, and the blazing fire was ignited under the entire Dan furnace.

The eyes of Gong Qianxue looked forward to Jianfeng. "Brother, please!"

"Do not worry, Shimei." The deep feelings of Jianfeng's eyes flashed away. "I will definitely let you get what you want."

Just then, there was a loud bang in the alchemy furnace.

Gong Qianxue made a scream, only to feel the pain, and was smashed out.

Vaguely, she seems to hear Mu Yan's screaming and madly crying: "Miyachiki, even if it turns into a devil, I will never let you go!!"

The fire broke and the entire alchemy room swayed a few times and collapsed completely.
